name: samugen
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @samugen/i18n && npm run test -w @samugen/docx-engine && npm run test -w @samugen/file-parse && npm run test -w @samugen/hwpx-convert && npm run test -w @samugen/pdf-edit && npm run test -w @samugen/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @samugen/pptx-render && npm run test -w @samugen/ai-search && npm run test -w @samugen/agent-core && npm run test -w @samugen/ai-provider && npm run test -w @samugen/project-store && npm run test -w @samugen/platform && npm run test -w @samugen/platform-web && npm run test -w @samugen/ai-bff && npm run test -w @samugen/docs && npm run test -w @samugen/sheets && npm run test -w @samugen/shell && npm run test -w @samugen/slides && npm run test -w @samugen/pdf
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @samugen/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/hwpx-convert && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/pdf-edit && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/platform && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/platform-web && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/ai-bff && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/ui && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/docs && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/shell && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/slides && npm run typecheck -w @samugen/pdf
scripts.docs:web: concurrently -k -n bff,docs -c magenta,blue "npm run start -w @samugen/ai-bff" "npm run dev:web -w @samugen/docs"
scripts.sheets:web: concurrently -k -n bff,sheets -c magenta,green "npm run start -w @samugen/ai-bff" "npm run dev:web -w @samugen/sheets"
scripts.slides:web: concurrently -k -n bff,slides -c magenta,yellow "npm run start -w @samugen/ai-bff" "npm run dev:web -w @samugen/slides"
scripts.pdf:web: concurrently -k -n bff,pdf -c magenta,red "npm run start -w @samugen/ai-bff" "npm run dev:web -w @samugen/pdf"
scripts.shell:web: concurrently -k -n bff,docs,pdf,slides,sheets,shell -c magenta,blue,red,yellow,green,cyan "npm run start -w @samugen/ai-bff" "DOCS_WEB_BASE=/app/docs/ npm run dev:web -w @samugen/docs" "PDF_WEB_BASE=/app/pdf/ npm run dev:web -w @samugen/pdf" "SLIDES_WEB_BASE=/app/slides/ npm run dev:web -w @samugen/slides" "SHEETS_WEB_BASE=/app/sheets/ npm run dev:web -w @samugen/sheets" "npm run dev:web -w @samugen/shell"
scripts.build:sheets:web: npm run wasm:build -w @samugen/sheets && npm run build:web -w @samugen/sheets
scripts.build:shell:web: npm run wasm:build -w @samugen/sheets && npm run build:web -w @samugen/shell && DOCS_WEB_BASE=/app/docs/ DOCS_WEB_OUT_DIR=../../../shell/dist/web/app/docs npm run build:web -w @samugen/docs && PDF_WEB_BASE=/app/pdf/ PDF_WEB_OUT_DIR=../../../shell/dist/web/app/pdf npm run build:web -w @samugen/pdf && SLIDES_WEB_BASE=/app/slides/ SLIDES_WEB_OUT_DIR=../../../shell/dist/web/app/slides npm run build:web -w @samugen/slides && SHEETS_WEB_BASE=/app/sheets/ SHEETS_WEB_OUT_DIR=../../../shell/dist/web/app/sheets npm run build:web -w @samugen/sheets
